acceptance: Cargo.toml pins crates.io tpcdsgen with no `[patch]` or git dependency.
TPC-DS parity at SF 0.01, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5 and 1 passes for all 24 tables; README carried-patch list is empty.
description:
## Problem
The library carries tpcgen-rs PR #677 as a pinned fork commit. The carried-patch rule requires removing it when an upstream release contains it.

## Change
On an upstream release containing #677: pin the crates.io version, delete the `[patch]` entry and the README entry, re-run parity.

## Decision gates
- Blocked until an upstream release contains #677 (no known date).
- If upstream merges a different API, adapt only if the change stays small; otherwise report sizes to the owner.
- If upstream rejects #677, report to the owner: the carried patch becomes permanent and needs a renewed decision.

## Guardrails
- BenchBox work only in a linked worktree; heavy work only through make heavy-run; never kill processes by name pattern.
- No divergent fork of tpcgen-rs; carried patches only under the 2026-11-27 rule (<= ~200 changed lines, upstream PR, SHA pin, README entry); anything larger goes to the owner with sizes first.
- Human commit identity, no agent attribution. Report only observed results.
